<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-10-1508-01-44" status="unreviewed">
               <milestone n="rang gi lugs rnam par gzhag pa" unit="section"/>
               rang gi lugs rnaM par gzhag pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog lo tsa ba</rs> na re chos ci dbyings cha shas med pa yin pas dbyings rtogs pa la khyad med pa la | de nyid la
            blo'i byed pa mi 'dra bas sgro 'dogs mi 'dra ba gcod pas ni khyad yod do zhes zer te 
            de ni kho bo cag dang don mthun no ||
            des na sa dang po nas bcu' ba'i bar du chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo rtogs pa la <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="246b9"/> khyad ba la || chos kyi dbyingss kyi ldog pa'i khyad par mi 'dra ba rtogs pa ni bcu'i mnyam bzhag nas sa yod pa nyid do || de lta °° chub dang rigs pas shes ste sngar bshad zin to || </seg></TEI>
